entries.en: The quartermaster must accoutre the recruits before they leave.
entries.zh: 军需官必须在新兵离开前给他们配齐军用品。

entries.en: The cliff exposes several accretionary layers of sediment.
entries.zh: 悬崖露出了几层堆积形成的沉积物。

entries.en: The model describes an accretive process that adds material gradually.
entries.zh: 这个模型描述了一个逐渐添加物质的增积过程。

entries.en: The office processes applications for social assistance.
entries.zh: 这个办公室办理社会救济申请。

entries.en: We need to thrash out the remaining details together.
entries.zh: 我们需要一起充分讨论，解决剩余的细节问题。

entries.en: The chart shows the spot price of copper.
entries.zh: 图表显示了铜的现货价格。

entries.en: They stopped for fast food on the drive home.
entries.zh: 他们开车回家途中停下来吃了快餐。

entries.en: The clinic has a separate room for play therapy.
entries.zh: 这家诊所有一个专门用于游戏疗法的房间。

entries.en: The missing terrier was found at the dog pound.
entries.zh: 那只走失的梗犬在流浪犬收容所里被找到了。

entries.en: The study tracks the gradual accruement of sediment in the basin.
entries.zh: 这项研究追踪了盆地中沉积物的逐渐累积。

entries.en: The sculpture depicts an accumbent figure resting on one elbow.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑描绘了一个用单肘支撑着横卧的人物。

entries.en: The half title carries no subtitle or publisher's name.
entries.zh: 这本书的半扉页只有书名，没有副标题或出版社名称。

entries.en: The report compares public debt with annual tax revenue.
entries.zh: 报告将公债与年度税收收入进行了比较。

entries.en: The accountant used the straight-line method for the equipment.
entries.zh: 会计采用直线折旧法计提这批设备的折旧。

entries.en: Selling the shares below their purchase price produced a capital loss.
entries.zh: 以低于买入价的价格出售股票造成了资本损失。

entries.en: The young company sought risk capital for its untested design.
entries.zh: 这家年轻的公司为其未经验证的设计寻求风险资本。

entries.en: The villagers feared the accurst tower beyond the marsh.
entries.zh: 村民们害怕沼泽那边那座受到诅咒的塔。

entries.en: The accusal named three officials and described the missing funds.
entries.zh: 这份控告点名了三名官员，并描述了失踪的资金。

entries.en: In this exercise, mark each noun in the accusative.
entries.zh: 在这个练习中，标出每个宾格名词。

entries.en: I do not want to lie around all weekend.
entries.zh: 我不想整个周末都闲着无所事事。

entries.en: Several witnesses agreed to step forward after the appeal.
entries.zh: 呼吁发出后，几名证人同意站出来。

entries.en: The hospital record described the injury as a second-degree burn.
entries.zh: 医院记录将这处损伤描述为二度烧伤。

entries.en: They shut away the fragile objects before the builders arrived.
entries.zh: 工人到来前，他们把易碎物品锁了起来。

entries.en: She checked her appointment book before offering a time.
entries.zh: 她先查看预约簿，再提出了一个时间。

entries.meaningZh: 创造新的事物而不影响原物的大小[稳定性]
entries.en: The main project may spin off several useful tools.
entries.zh: 主项目可能衍生出几种有用的工具。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the acebutolol label against the prescription.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照处方核对了醋丁洛尔的标签。

entries.en: The telescope detected a faint radio source near the galaxy.
entries.zh: 望远镜在那个星系附近探测到了一个微弱射电源。

entries.en: Roasted carrots came as a side dish with the chicken.
entries.zh: 鸡肉配了一份烤胡萝卜作为配菜。

entries.en: The industrial union represents workers with many different skills.
entries.zh: 这个产业工会代表拥有多种不同技能的工人。

entries.en: The market delivers fresh food to the village each morning.
entries.zh: 市场每天早上向村庄运送新鲜食品。

entries.en: The auction house displayed the painting before the sale.
entries.zh: 拍卖行在拍卖前展示了这幅画。

entries.en: The invitation asked the gentlemen to wear full dress.
entries.zh: 请柬要求男宾穿着正式晚礼服。

entries.en: We watched the larger ship bear down on our boat.
entries.zh: 我们看着那艘大船向我们的小船驶来。

entries.en: The medieval sermon warned against acedia and neglected duties.
entries.zh: 那篇中世纪布道告诫人们不要精神怠惰、忽视责任。

entries.en: The artist arranged the shapes in an acentric composition.
entries.zh: 画家把这些形状安排成了没有中心的构图。

entries.en: The chief executive officer presented the plan to the board.
entries.zh: 首席执行官向董事会提交了这项计划。

entries.en: The city manager outlined the new waste collection schedule.
entries.zh: 市执行长介绍了新的垃圾收集时间表。

entries.en: The handbook explains how employees apply for sick pay.
entries.zh: 手册解释了员工如何申请病假工资。

entries.en: He saved his pocket money for a second-hand bicycle.
entries.zh: 他攒下零用钱，打算买一辆二手自行车。

entries.en: The pressure unit on this chart is the millimeter of mercury.
entries.zh: 这张图表使用的压力单位是毫米汞柱。

entries.en: The author discussed her new book on a chat show.
entries.zh: 这位作者在访谈节目中谈到了自己的新书。

entries.en: A famous person can rarely cross this square unnoticed.
entries.zh: 名人走过这个广场时很难不被认出来。

entries.en: The damaged statue was acephalous when the museum acquired it.
entries.zh: 博物馆收购这尊受损雕像时，它已经没有头部了。

entries.en: The treasurer reviewed the firm's outstanding commercial paper.
entries.zh: 财务主管审查了公司尚未清偿的商业本票。

entries.en: The diagram places each biological group on a separate branch.
entries.zh: 这张图将每个生物群类放在单独的分支上。

entries.en: The table reports a first-order correlation controlling for age.
entries.zh: 表中报告了控制年龄之后的一阶偏相关。

entries.en: Every business establishment on the street received a survey.
entries.zh: 街上每个营业场所都收到了一份调查表。

entries.en: The new water supply improved the village's standard of living.
entries.zh: 新的供水设施改善了村庄的生活水平。

entries.en: The exhibit traces the early years of the space program.
entries.zh: 展览回顾了这项航天计划的早期岁月。

entries.en: The specimen has narrow, acerate leaves.
entries.zh: 这个标本长着狭窄的针状叶。

entries.en: His acerb remarks spoiled an otherwise friendly discussion.
entries.zh: 他刻薄的话语破坏了原本友好的讨论气氛。

entries.en: Another dismissive reply would only acerbate the disappointed team.
entries.zh: 再给一个敷衍的答复只会使失望的团队更加气恼。

entries.en: The festival screened a feature film after two short documentaries.
entries.zh: 电影节在两部短纪录片之后放映了一部长片。

entries.en: Please wipe off the chalk before writing the next question.
entries.zh: 写下一道题之前，请先擦掉粉笔字。

entries.en: A religious leader welcomed visitors to the monastery.
entries.zh: 一位宗教领袖欢迎来客参观修道院。

entries.en: She recorded the conference fee as a business expense.
entries.zh: 她把会议费记为业务支出。

entries.en: Each colour corresponds to a different scale value.
entries.zh: 每种颜色对应一个不同的标度值。

entries.en: The piano barely fitted through the double door.
entries.zh: 钢琴勉强穿过了那扇双扇门。

entries.en: An acerola grew in a large pot beside the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 温室旁的大花盆里长着一株金虎尾。

entries.en: The artist carefully drew the plant's acerose leaves.
entries.zh: 画家仔细地画出了这株植物的针状叶。

entries.en: The photograph shows an acervate fungal growth on the wood.
entries.zh: 照片显示木头上有一片成堆生长的真菌。

entries.en: The ticket office opens an hour before the performance.
entries.zh: 售票处在演出前一小时开放。

entries.en: The engineer inserted a delay line into the circuit.
entries.zh: 工程师在电路中接入了一条延迟线。

entries.en: You can skip over the introduction on your second reading.
entries.zh: 第二次阅读时，你可以略过引言。

entries.en: The model depicts a high-angle gun on its original carriage.
entries.zh: 这个模型展示了一门装在原式炮架上的曲射炮。

entries.en: The scan report described the acetabular margin in detail.
entries.zh: 扫描报告详细描述了髋臼边缘。

entries.en: The instructor pointed to the acetabulum on the pelvis model.
entries.zh: 教师指着骨盆模型上的髋臼。

entries.en: The historical inventory lists acetanilid among the laboratory's compounds.
entries.zh: 历史清单把退热剂乙酰苯胺列在实验室的化合物之中。

entries.en: The custody dispute was heard in family court.
entries.zh: 这场监护权纠纷在家庭法庭审理。

entries.en: She tucked a pocket book into her coat for the journey.
entries.zh: 她把一本袖珍书塞进外套，准备路上读。

entries.en: The sculptor carefully shaped the statue's great toe.
entries.zh: 雕塑家仔细塑造了雕像的大脚趾。

entries.en: The nurse recorded his blood pressure on the chart.
entries.zh: 护士把他的血压记在了记录表上。

entries.en: They rented a cold-water flat above a bakery.
entries.zh: 他们在一家面包店楼上租了一套只供应冷水的公寓。

entries.en: The academy admitted only an elite group of researchers.
entries.zh: 这所研究院只接纳了一批精英研究人员。

entries.en: The doorway is decorated with flowers carved in low relief.
entries.zh: 门口装饰着用浅浮雕雕刻的花朵。

entries.en: The chemist labelled the sealed sample acetanilide.
entries.zh: 化学家把密封样品标记为N-乙酰苯胺。

entries.en: The exposed liquid began to acetify during storage.
entries.zh: 暴露在空气中的液体在储存期间开始变酸。

entries.en: The medical record included an earlier diagnosis of acetonemia.
entries.zh: 病历中记载了先前的丙酮血症诊断。

entries.en: She jokingly called her bright lipstick war paint.
entries.zh: 她开玩笑地把鲜艳的口红称作自己的战妆。

entries.en: Only four people managed to show up before noon.
entries.zh: 中午之前只有四个人赶到了。

entries.en: The technician matched each part name to the numbered diagram.
entries.zh: 技术员将每个零件名称与编号示意图一一对应。

entries.en: We fitted the line using the method of least squares.
entries.zh: 我们用最小二乘法拟合了这条直线。

entries.en: The archivist managed to ferret out the missing correspondence.
entries.zh: 档案管理员设法搜出了缺失的信件。

entries.en: The diagram outlines the different levels of the judicial system.
entries.zh: 这张图概述了法院系统的不同层级。

entries.en: The laboratory report describes the sample's acetonic odour.
entries.zh: 实验室报告描述了样品的丙酮气味。

entries.en: The laboratory form had a separate entry for acetonuria.
entries.zh: 实验室表格中有一项单独记录丙酮尿。

entries.en: The catalogue lists acetophenetidin under its older chemical name.
entries.zh: 目录以较旧的化学名称列出了乙酰氧乙苯胺。

entries.en: The press lord owned newspapers in several cities.
entries.zh: 那位新闻业巨头在几个城市都拥有报纸。

entries.en: He showed his union card at the meeting entrance.
entries.zh: 他在会场入口出示了工会会员证。

entries.en: The meter records the flow rate through the pipe.
entries.zh: 仪表记录着通过管道的流量。

entries.en: Her tax bill was larger than she had expected.
entries.zh: 她的税单金额比预期的高。

entries.en: She tried to freeze off an unwelcome admirer with icy politeness.
entries.zh: 她试图以冰冷的客气打发走一位不受欢迎的追求者。

entries.en: A panoramic photograph fills the magazine's centre spread.
entries.zh: 一张全景照片占满了杂志的中心跨页。

entries.en: An acetose smell drifted from the open jar.
entries.zh: 敞开的罐子里飘出一股像醋的酸味。

entries.en: The stale wine had an unpleasant acetous taste.
entries.zh: 变质的葡萄酒有一股令人不快的醋酸味。

entries.en: The archive preserves a handwritten inventory mentioning acetphenetidin.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一份提到非那西汀的手写清单。

entries.en: Flight control radioed new instructions to the pilot.
entries.zh: 地面飞行控制通过无线电向飞行员发出了新指令。

entries.en: I need a few days to chew over your proposal.
entries.zh: 我需要几天时间仔细考虑你的提议。

entries.en: She rinsed off the face pack before answering the door.
entries.zh: 她洗掉面膜后才去开门。

entries.en: A stagehand watched the ropes from the fly floor.
entries.zh: 一位舞台工作人员在舞台天桥上看管绳索。

entries.en: Can you stick around until the delivery arrives?
entries.zh: 你能留下来等到送货的人来吗？

entries.en: His repeated hints were a mind game designed to unsettle us.
entries.zh: 他反复暗示是为了让我们不安的心理战术。

entries.en: The old recipe calls for a spoonful of acetum.
entries.zh: 这份旧食谱需要一勺醋。

entries.en: The scheme shows where chemists acetylate the starting compound.
entries.zh: 反应示意图显示了化学家在何处使起始化合物乙酰化。

entries.en: The paper compares acetylation in two laboratory procedures.
entries.zh: 这篇论文比较了两个实验步骤中的乙酰化作用。

entries.en: We need to trim back spending on printed leaflets.
entries.zh: 我们需要削减印刷传单的开支。

entries.en: The judgment discusses whether the hearing followed due process.
entries.zh: 判决讨论了听证是否遵循法定诉讼程序。

entries.en: The travellers changed horses at the post house.
entries.zh: 旅客们在驿站换了马。

entries.en: The landlord included cable television service in the rent.
entries.zh: 房东将有线电视服务包含在租金之内。

entries.en: In the film, the guard begins to loose off several shots.
entries.zh: 电影中，警卫开始连开数枪。

entries.en: A flower seller stood on the street corner.
entries.zh: 一个卖花人站在街角。

entries.en: The account executive arranged a meeting with the client.
entries.zh: 客户经理安排了与客户的会面。

entries.en: Two volunteers will stand watch beside the camp tonight.
entries.zh: 今晚会有两名志愿者在营地旁警戒。

entries.en: They bought a narrow row house near the station.
entries.zh: 他们在车站附近买了一栋狭窄的联排式住宅。

entries.en: The spreadsheet calculates the average cost per finished item.
entries.zh: 电子表格计算每件成品的平均成本。

entries.en: This logical system uses only three basic rules.
entries.zh: 这个逻辑系统只使用三条基本规则。

entries.en: The mechanic checked the car's electrical system before replacing the battery.
entries.zh: 更换电池之前，机械师检查了汽车的电气系统。

entries.en: The diagram identifies the site where the enzymes acetylize the molecule.
entries.zh: 示意图指出了这些酶使分子发生乙酰化的位置。

entries.en: The public wash room is beside the information desk.
entries.zh: 公共盥洗室在问讯处旁边。

entries.en: The archive contains a demand note signed by the merchant.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张由那位商人签署的即期票据。

entries.en: Our car pool takes turns driving to the industrial park.
entries.zh: 我们这群拼车的人轮流开车去工业园。

entries.en: We watched the television news while preparing dinner.
entries.zh: 我们一边准备晚餐，一边看电视新闻。

entries.en: The rain will soak through this thin jacket.
entries.zh: 雨水会浸透这件薄外套。

entries.en: The achlamydeous flower lacks both petals and sepals.
entries.zh: 这朵无花被的花既没有花瓣，也没有萼片。

entries.en: The specialist added achlorhydria to the medical history.
entries.zh: 专科医生将胃酸缺乏补充进了病史。

entries.en: The report describes the gastric sample as achlorhydric.
entries.zh: 报告将胃液样品描述为缺乏盐酸。

entries.en: We arrived at the tail end of the discussion.
entries.zh: 我们在讨论快结束时到达。

entries.en: The museum film documented a traditional war dance.
entries.zh: 博物馆的影片记录了一种传统的战阵舞。

entries.en: The branches arch over the narrow garden path.
entries.zh: 树枝呈拱形悬在狭窄的花园小径之上。

entries.en: The windows mist over when everyone comes inside.
entries.zh: 大家进屋后，窗户上蒙了一层水汽。

entries.en: The recorder measured the noise level after midnight.
entries.zh: 记录仪测量了午夜之后的噪声级。

entries.en: The carved chair is a period piece from an earlier century.
entries.zh: 这把雕花椅子是一件来自更早世纪的古式家具。

entries.en: The old clinical notes mention acholia without further detail.
entries.zh: 旧的临床笔记提到了无胆汁症，但没有更多细节。

entries.en: The geologist identified the stone as an achondrite.
entries.zh: 地质学家认出这块石头是一块不含球粒的陨石。

entries.en: The overfilled pockets bulge out beneath his jacket.
entries.zh: 装得太满的口袋在他的夹克下面鼓了出来。

entries.en: The students performed a medieval mystery play in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 学生们在庭院里演出了一部中世纪神秘剧。

entries.en: The staged handshake created a useful photo opportunity for both leaders.
entries.zh: 安排好的握手为两位领导人都提供了有利的拍照机会。

entries.en: The house physician checked the ward before the morning meeting.
entries.zh: 住院内科医师在晨会前查看了病房。

entries.en: She chose royal blue for the new curtains.
entries.zh: 她为新窗帘选择了品蓝色。

entries.en: We can pack together the smaller boxes to save space.
entries.zh: 我们可以把较小的箱子紧密放在一起，节省空间。

entries.en: The genetics seminar included a family history involving achondroplasia.
entries.zh: 遗传学研讨会包含了一份涉及软骨发育不全的家族史。

entries.en: The specialist discussed the achondroplastic findings in the case report.
entries.zh: 专科医生讨论了病例报告中的软骨发育不全表现。

entries.en: The historical index files this case under achondroplasty.
entries.zh: 历史索引把这个病例归在软骨发育不全之下。

entries.en: The executive director approved the revised staffing plan.
entries.zh: 执行董事批准了修改后的人事配置计划。

entries.en: Their first recording was a cover song from the seventies.
entries.zh: 他们录制的第一首歌翻唱自七十年代的歌曲。

entries.en: The tutor reviews each student's work on an individual basis.
entries.zh: 导师逐一审阅每位学生的作业。

entries.en: The report raised concerns about possible child neglect.
entries.zh: 报告对可能存在的儿童疏于照管问题表示了担忧。

entries.en: He suspected his smiling business partner would play false.
entries.zh: 他怀疑那位笑容满面的商业伙伴会弄虚作假。

entries.en: The computer program sorts the records by date.
entries.zh: 这个计算机程序按日期整理记录。

entries.en: The technician disconnected the power cable before moving the machine.
entries.zh: 技术员先断开电源电缆，再移动机器。

entries.en: The photograph's achromaticity directs attention to shape and texture.
entries.zh: 这张照片的无彩色特性使注意力集中于形状和质感。

entries.en: The microscope exercise asked students to distinguish achromatin from stained material.
entries.zh: 显微镜练习要求学生区分非染色质与染色物质。

entries.en: He told a funny story about losing his umbrella.
entries.zh: 他讲了一个自己丢伞的幽默故事。

entries.en: We stopped for bread on the way home.
entries.zh: 我们在回家途中停下来买了面包。

entries.en: The rescue team brought medical aid to the stranded hikers.
entries.zh: 救援队向受困的徒步者提供了医疗救助。

entries.en: The report compares the inflation rate with wage growth.
entries.zh: 报告比较了通货膨胀率与工资增长率。

entries.en: The kitten looked ever so small beside the dog.
entries.zh: 小猫在那只狗旁边显得非常小。

entries.en: The nurse recorded how much mother's milk the baby received.
entries.zh: 护士记录了婴儿摄入的母乳量。

entries.en: The diagram separates achromatinic material from the darker nuclear regions.
entries.zh: 示意图将非染色质物质与较深色的细胞核区域区分开来。

entries.en: The display uses achromatism to emphasize contrasts of light and dark.
entries.zh: 这个展示采用无彩色效果来突出明暗对比。

entries.en: The certificate identifies the shares as no-par-value stock.
entries.zh: 这张股票凭证将这些股份标明为无面值股票。

entries.en: The railway follows the river through a narrow water gap.
entries.zh: 铁路沿着河流穿过一条狭窄的水隙峡谷。

entries.en: The pupils sang a major scale before practising the song.
entries.zh: 学生们在练歌之前唱了一遍大音阶。

entries.en: The developer discussed funding at a power breakfast with investors.
entries.zh: 开发商在与投资者的早餐商务会议上讨论了资金问题。
